claim_limits: The 0.6.7 engine is an explicit coarse-grained material chemostat calibrated as a long-horizon instrument; it is not the full 0.6.6 particle microphysics.
HGT rescue is claimed only when sequence acquisition, re-entry, and persistent descendants are all observed.
Environment-dependent retention is not open-ended evolution or proof of life.
Long-delay information is supplied only as an accounted extracellular cue reservoir; cells receive no future niche label or switch-time flag.
Founder module proteins are explicit initial material; descendants and HGT recipients must synthesize module protein from structural matter and ATP.

primary_gates.long_delay_expression: Across HGT-ON holdouts, long-delay mean_active_modules exceeds stable by >=0.50 and is higher in at least 2/3 paired seeds.
primary_gates.long_horizon: For every main condition, at least 2/3 runs reach generation >=15; at least one registered run reaches generation >=20.
primary_gates.material: Every registered run is finite, external_fitness_events=0, and max_abs_material_residual < 1e-7.
primary_gates.no_posthoc_seed_selection: All listed holdout seeds and conditions are reported, including failures.
primary_gates.stable_hgt_rescue: In at least 2/3 paired stable seeds, HGT-ON reduces absent frequency by >=0.30 versus HGT-OFF, records >=1 HGT grammar re-entry, and ends with >=1 persistent re-entry-lineage cell that still carries grammar.
primary_gates.stable_loss_without_hgt: In stable HGT-OFF, at least 2/3 runs finish with grammar_absent_frequency >=0.75 and mean_active_modules <=0.5.

purpose: Test generation-15/20 neural-grammar loss, material HGT re-entry, and long-delay-specific retention without organism-facing fitness or experimenter lineage replacement.
